title: PlotaLoom
tagline: Trust the Weave, Bid Confidently, Communicate Anonymously – Redefining Property Dealings Globally with PlotaLoom.
description:
The traditional dealings of property have long grappled with issues like scams and conflicts, creating hurdles in the smooth functioning of the land industry and we often come across cases like these with online property-selling platforms. However, when it comes to buying or selling property, a decentralized solution seems hard to find. ☹️

There comes a **PlotaLoom** – a game-changer in private property dealings! 🚪

PlotaLoom is an innovative solution that revolutionizes property dealings by providing a **decentralized land marketplace**. We effectively get rid of scams and conflicts that usually cause problems in traditional property dealings. 

Our platform offers a secure user experience through **efficient wallet logins** and **location-based verifications** and leverages **Anon-Aadhar** for the Indian region and **Polygon ID** globally as the singularity of the user. Anonymity is a cornerstone that ensures buyers and sellers communicate securely. 🔐

We protect the identity maintaining the **privacy of users** in real-time chats and issue a warning through **Push** whenever an attempt is made to disclose personal information. We aim to resolve conflicts arising from multiple users vying for the same property through **auctions and bidding**, promoting fairness in dealings. Leveraging blockchain enhances overall security, addressing vulnerabilities present in conventional property dealings. 🔔

Beyond the initial stages, the monetization strategy will see an implementation of innovative revenue streams, including **premium subscriptions** and **minimum transaction fees**, ensuring a diversified income model. With an eye on finance scalability, we plan to tailor its platform to meet the distinct property regulations and user preferences of various regions. Collaborations with strategic influencers will further propel PlotaLoom's evolution into a market leader, fostering continued success in the decentralized landscape of Web3 eventually in the real world. 💰

how_its_made:
We faced several tech-stack challenges:

- While working with **Anon-Aadhar SDK**, we weren't able to test it in our **local system**. Further, we were provided with the **dependencies** by the officials which were limited to **Next** and couldn’t support our existing **Vite** based client. That made us create **2 clients.** 🫠
- **Polygon ID** integration was a bit tricky because the **js-iden3-auth SDK** had some functionalities that were about to come soon **(JSW)** which was the first step to implement. **(Navbar-> Tools https://devs.polygonid.com/)** 👀
- We faced **privacy concerns** in Lighthouse integration due to the absence of encryption libraries in their **Python SDK**. 🛠️
- Integration complexities between **Python and JavaScript** based frameworks.
- Consideration of **authentication methods** in Web3, eventually chose Moralis after a brief discussion with mentors. 🔒 

Overall, transitioning from **Web2 to Web3** was challenging, but we enjoyed it as a team! 🙌
